messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment finished: release/edge-2026.03.22 -> prod (batch 2/5). Running post-deploy smoke sequence: quickcheck, embed-synth, kv-warmup. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/ops/3765432100 :rocket:
maya: saw the deploybot message, starting quickcheck now.
omar: on it — running eu1 quick synthetic probe (embed route)
qa-priya: kicked off the QA harness against canary subset (10%). will report failures inline.
maya: quickcheck summary: all healthchecks green except eu1 embed p95 ~ 970ms (threshold 900ms). small jitter on second wave. no 5xx.
omar: eu1 synth shows elevation of 429s on embed route for short window (10:03:12-10:03:25) ~0.5% of samples. tail latency spike lines up with a backing KV miss flood in the logs.
alice: can you paste the KV error snippet?
omar: ```
2026-03-22T10:03:14Z eu1 embed-service warn kvcache miss batch=128 keys=240 miss_ratio=0.67
2026-03-22T10:03:15Z eu1 embed-service error redis timeout model-weights fetch id=embed-v2.3.2 latency=450ms
```
ben_sre: curious — that redis timeout looks transient. we saw a similar pattern last month when prefill was misaligned during warmup.
qa-priya: functional checks passed; regressions/noise checks show parity vs last release on most routes but embed p95 regressed ~8%.
maya: rollout batch 2 includes eu1 and us-west. Should we pause batch 3 (global)? we have the change window til 11:30.
alice: suggestion: hold further batches, pin eu1 routing to previous model variant (embed-v2.3.1) while we triage. minimize blast radius.
ben_sre: +1 for regional pin. Can we do a safe route pin with 100% eu1 to v2.3.1 and keep us-west on v2.3.2?
omar: yes, we can use routing policy: route-prefix embed->eu1 weight 0/1 to v2.3.2 and 1 to v2.3.1. executing now.
deploy-bot: Route update applied: embed-route eu1 pinned to embed-v2.3.1 (change id: cid-3765432100-a). Audit: https://audit.redwood.ai/changes/cid-3765432100-a
maya: re-running eu1 synth after pin.
qa-priya: new synth run: p95 540ms, 429s back to 0.02%. Nice.
ben_sre: good. That confirms regression is model-variant dependent or related to cache warmup patterns for v2.3.2.
alice: rollout hold confirmed. We should update release notes and the change window slack announcement: note regional pin in eu1 and hold on global.
maya: draft message: "Holding global rollout — eu1 pinned to embed-v2.3.1 due to embed p95 regression during warmup. Investigating kvcache warmup interaction with v2.3.2. No user-facing errors observed. Will update in 30m." anyone want to add?
omar: add that no rollbacks were performed and that canaries remain healthy in us-west.
ben_sre: ops action: start a short load-replay against v2.3.2 in eu1 scaled-down env to reproduce kv cache miss pattern (ticket INF-3487).
alice: assign INF-3487 to eng-runtime and eng-ml. please include perf traces and allocator logs.
qa-priya: i'm pinning the release notes draft and adding a postmortem checklist entry.
deploy-bot: Release status: hold applied. Next scheduled batch suspended. Notifying release leads.
maya: Thanks all. I'll keep this thread updated with triage findings. :thumbsup:
